name: title-to-new-game
description: From the title boot point (T = 1250) to New Game, without knowing where the menu cursor starts (#74 Tier 2: Circle alone left the title on screen; Down moves the picture). Circle (New Game if the cursor is there); Cross twice, to back out of whatever Circle opened if the cursor was on the other entry; Down, to the other entry; Circle again. If the first Circle started New Game, the later presses fall on the fade-out and the opening movie, which take no input. 720 frames. Hypotheses about the game's menu, judged only by what follows; no FF7 address is used.
